name: Java 7 diamond operator for generic type inference
description: Java 7 allows replacing explicit type arguments in generic constructor calls with the diamond operator (<>). This simplifies code like new HashMap<String,String>() to new HashMap<>().

patterns.reason: Java 7 introduced type inference for generic instance creation (the diamond operator), allowing empty angle brackets <> to replace explicit type arguments when the compiler can infer them from context.

verification_hint: Replace explicit generic type arguments with diamond operator (<>). Verify compilation succeeds on Java 7 with no type inference errors.

name: Java 7 strings in switch statements
description: Java 7 allows using String objects in switch statements. This enables converting if-else chains based on equals() comparisons on a String variable into cleaner switch statements.

patterns.reason: Java 7 added String support in switch statements. if-else chains comparing String equality with .equals() can be converted to switch statements for improved readability and performance.

verification_hint: Convert if-else chains with equals() on String to switch statements. Verify compilation succeeds on Java 7 with no semantic changes.

name: Java 7 try-with-resources for automatic resource management
description: Java 7 introduced try-with-resources, which ensures automatic closing of resources (InputStream, OutputStream, Reader, Writer, Connection, etc.) that implement AutoCloseable or Closeable.

patterns.reason: Java 7 introduced try-with-resources statement for automatic resource management. Objects implementing java.lang.AutoCloseable or java.io.Closeable can be used as resources. This is a modernization opportunity to simplify resource cleanup.

verification_hint: Convert try-finally resource cleanup patterns to try-with-resources. This is an optional modernization — informational only.
